description: This file defines the QueueFragment class for an Android media browsing app. It manages UI components (play controls, list of media queue), handles media session connection, updates playback state, and responds to user interactions within a music app context.

classes.name: QueueFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays the media playback queue, handles media session connection, controls playback, and updates UI based on playback state.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of QueueFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout, initializes UI components, sets click listeners, and establishes the MediaBrowser connection.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Connects the MediaBrowser when the fragment is resumed.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Unregisters callbacks and disconnects the MediaBrowser when the fragment is paused.

methods.name: onPlaybackStateChanged
methods.description: Updates UI elements based on the current playback state.
